provenance.notes: Pro family batch. These are non-attorney document services: copy never implies legal services, never promises an approval or a timeline from any agency, and every build carries a not-a-law-firm notice. Registration and bond details are bracketed placeholders. Spanish version treated as core.

pageStructurePlus.section: Not a law firm notice, in every language
pageStructurePlus.contains: A plain statement that the business is not a law firm, cannot give legal advice or choose immigration forms, the [state registration or bond number] where required, and how to find a licensed attorney or accredited representative
pageStructurePlus.why: Many states require it, and families who have been hurt by notario fraud look for this honesty before anything else on the page.

pageStructurePlus.section: Certified translation price list by document
pageStructurePlus.contains: Birth and marriage certificates, diplomas, transcripts, bank letters and police records, priced per page or per document, with the certification statement, turnaround and rush options
pageStructurePlus.why: Translation buyers compare by document and deadline. A per-document price list answers both and stops the 'how much for my birth certificate' call.

pageStructurePlus.contains: Which countries accept an apostille and which need embassy legalization, state versus federal documents, the order of steps, turnaround and mail-in instructions
pageStructurePlus.why: People sending documents abroad are confused and on a deadline. A clear sequence makes this office the one that sorts it out.

pageStructurePlus.section: What we can and cannot do
pageStructurePlus.contains: Typing forms at the client's direction, translation, copies, notarization, passport photos and mailing, set beside what only an attorney may do: advice, choosing forms and representation
pageStructurePlus.why: It protects the business and the client, and it reads as integrity to someone who has heard bad stories about document preparers.

pageStructurePlus.section: Written contract, receipts and original documents
pageStructurePlus.contains: A written contract before any service, itemised fees, receipts for every payment, originals returned the same day, and the refund terms required by [state document preparer rules]
pageStructurePlus.why: Trust is the whole sale. Showing the paperwork habits up front separates a careful document office from the storefronts people warn each other about.

pageStructurePlus.section: Languages spoken and staff who speak them
pageStructurePlus.contains: Each language offered, which staff member speaks it, translation language pairs, and a Spanish version of every page
pageStructurePlus.why: Clients pick the document office where they can explain their situation in their own language. Naming the person who speaks it builds that trust.

objections.objection: My clients come from the community. They don't search online.
objections.handler: "They come from the community and then check you on their phone before handing over a passport. The site is what confirms the recommendation, in their language."

objections.objection: I'm worried a website will get me in trouble with the state.
objections.handler: "That's the right worry. The site puts your not-a-law-firm notice and registration on every page and never says you give advice. It's the careful version of what you already do."

objections.objection: My nephew can make me a page in Spanish.
objections.handler: "Good, family help is valuable. Happy to hand over the translation price list and the notice wording. If it stalls, the offer stands."

objections.objection: Prices change depending on the document.
objections.handler: "That's why the price list is by document, with 'from' prices and rush options. People expect ranges; they want to know you won't surprise them."
"Then the site does a different job: fewer price calls, mail-in apostilles you can do between walk-ins, and documents uploaded before the client arrives."
"{Build Range}. For you about {Build Price}, for both languages, the price list, apostille steps and the notice pages. That's a few weeks of translations."

bullets: Treat the Spanish version as part of the build, not an add-on. A document office without it isn't finished.
Price extra languages per language, and only where a named staff member can check them.
The not-a-law-firm notice, contract policy and registration placeholders are mandatory on every build; never quote a build without them.
Never write approval, speed of any government agency, or 'immigration help' that implies advice. Describe tasks: typing, translating, copying, mailing.
Mail-in ordering with upload and payment is a separate line; it opens a statewide market and is priced like one.
Peg the build to a few weeks of translation and apostille orders, never to an hourly rate.

withoutAI.pitchLine: "Every immigration question you can't answer goes to an attorney. Those attorneys need careful bilingual sites, and your referrals make you a welcome introduction."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Attorneys value document offices that send them clients instead of overstepping, and they buy sites at a higher price.

withoutAI.route: Bilingual tax preparers serving the same families
withoutAI.pitchLine: "The tax preparer your document clients use every spring needs a Spanish site with a checklist. You can tell them who built yours."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: The same families use both offices, and the preparer trusts a neighbour's recommendation.

withoutAI.route: Mobile notaries who share translation clients
withoutAI.pitchLine: "The mobile notary you send apostille signers to needs a simple page with fees and zones. A quick introduction from your document office is all it takes."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Notaries are a volume buyer at a low price, and the referral loop runs both ways.

withoutAI.pitchLine: "The citizenship and English classes your clients attend need a sign-up site in two languages. Your office is already on their resource list."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Nonprofits often have grant money for outreach and trust local businesses that serve the same families.

withoutAI.pitchLine: "People who just had a foreign licence translated at your document office go straight to a driving school next. Those schools need Spanish booking pages."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: It's the next step in the same family's paperwork journey, and the school welcomes the referral source.

withoutAI.pitchLine: "The freelance translators who cover languages you don't need a one-page profile with their language pairs. Your document office is their best client."
withoutAI.whyItWorks: Freelancers buy small sites for credibility, and the introduction comes from the person who pays them.

withAI.route: Spanish intake summaries for immigration attorneys
withAI.pitchLine: "Immigration attorneys get consultation requests written in Spanish. An assistant drafts an English summary for bilingual staff to check before the attorney reads it."
withAI.whyItWorks: It shortens intake for the attorney, and the document office that introduced it earns goodwill and referrals back.

withAI.pitchLine: "The tax preparer who shares your document clients can text each family a checklist in their language and an assistant answers 'which form is this' about the papers."
withAI.whyItWorks: Preparers lose hours to missing papers every spring, and the families already know the tool from your referral.

withAI.pitchLine: "Mobile notaries who take your apostille signers can confirm appointments and ID rules in Spanish automatically, with the not-an-attorney line included."
withAI.whyItWorks: Small cost, fewer wasted drives, and the document office looks well connected.

withAI.route: Civics practice assistant for citizenship classes
withAI.pitchLine: "Students in the citizenship classes your document clients attend can practise civics questions in English with Spanish hints, any time of night."
withAI.whyItWorks: Nonprofits can fund it from education grants, and practice between classes is what students ask for.

withAI.route: Permit test practice in Spanish for driving schools
withAI.pitchLine: "New drivers who just had a licence translated at your document office can practise the permit test in Spanish with an assistant that explains each answer."
withAI.whyItWorks: Driving schools sell more lessons to students who pass the permit test first.

softwareAI.name: Ready-for-pickup texts for documents

softwareAI.name: Review reply drafts in the client's language

softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 2. Needs a few approved replies in each language. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Language-matched appointment calendar

softwareAI.name: Apostille order tracker with client status page
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Every apostille order tracked from documents received to sent to the state to back in hand, with a status link so clients stop calling to ask."

softwareAI.name: Written contract and receipt generator
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Each document service gets a written contract and an itemised receipt in the client's language, generated from the order, so the paperwork habits the state expects happen every time."

softwareAI.name: Original document custody log
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Every passport, certificate and diploma left at the document office is logged in and signed back out, so nothing is ever lost and the client sees the record."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 6. Needs their intake steps and who handles originals.

softwareAI.name: Upload quality check for document scans
softwareAI.pitchLine: "When a client uploads a document for translation, the tool flags a blurry stamp, a cut-off edge or a missing back page before the translator starts."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 5, after the upload quote. Needs a set of good and bad sample scans. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Apostille or legalization country table
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Clients pick the destination country and see whether their document needs an apostille or embassy legalization, from a table the office keeps current."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 4. Needs the owner's current country notes and the countries they serve most.

softwareAI.name: Translation job board by translator and deadline
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Every translation order on one board with its language pair, translator and due date, so rush jobs never slip behind the routine ones."

softwareAI.name: Name and date consistency checker
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Before a set of translations goes out, the tool compares names, dates and places across every document in the order and flags spelling that doesn't match."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 7. Needs sample document sets. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer; the translator makes every correction.

softwareAI.name: Mail-in payment and shipping label flow
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Mail-in apostille and translation clients pay online and get a printable label to send their documents, and a tracked return label goes out when the work is done."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 4. Needs their payment account and shipping account.

softwareAI.name: Bilingual call note summaries
softwareAI.pitchLine: "After a phone call in Spanish or English, staff get a short draft note of the documents discussed and the next step, saved to the client's document order."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Month 6. Needs their note format and consent wording for recorded calls. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Bilingual staff applicant screener
softwareAI.pitchLine: "Applicants for a document office assistant role answer questions about languages, typing and handling originals, and you only interview the ones who fit."
softwareAI.whenAndWhatItTakes: Whenever they post a role. Needs their must-haves. Comes with the AI maintenance retainer.

softwareAI.name: Monthly orders by service and language
softwareAI.pitchLine: "See how many translations, apostilles and walk-in document services came in each month, by language, so the owner knows which translator to add."

softwareAI.name: Mail-in order intake assistant
softwareAI.pitchLine: "It asks a mail-in client the destination country, the document type and the deadline, then sets up the apostille or translation order for staff to confirm."

softwareAI.name: Translation glossary manager

routesToBiggerBuyer.whyItWorks: Those owners already paid once for a site, so the decision is about finishing, not starting.
